reason: I've done this with Tiimo and Structured, I love it for ten days and then I forget it exists. Free is already enough for me and I'm not putting my own money on an app I'll drop.
objection: I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks, like every other one, so paying even $5 feels like paying for something I won't open.
would_change_my_mind: If I was still opening it daily after a month and the widget on my lock screen actually made me start stuff, I might get the Start Kit for $1.99.
